result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual clipping issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off — both the image and the restaurant name are clipped, making it clear there is more content but the truncation feels abrupt and the name is incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Either show a partial card with a clear visual affordance (e.g., a shadow or peek effect) to indicate horizontal scrollability, or ensure the restaurant name is truncated with an ellipsis properly styled within its container bounds.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen with no visible scroll indicator, making it slightly unclear that the page is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: This is somewhat intentional to hint at more content below, but adding a subtle scroll affordance or ensuring the cut-off is more deliberate (showing roughly 30-40% of the next card) would improve the UX signal.
